budget: at most three spec candidates per view; every --check run on a distinct spec counted

attempts.note: Earliest candidate: whole 6-node case in one tb view, groups transit/edge/tiers. Rejected on fit: check reported extent=34x69 (34 cols wide x 69 rows tall) and the pinned 77x47 dump printed the 'graph overflows - drag to pan' banner; the WAN node was off-screen. Region boxes for the one-member groups (transit, tiers) rendered detached from their member.

Front path wan->fw->core->web in lr with three regions transit/edge/tiers. Fit was fine (extent=77x12) and the 'edge' region rendered as a titled band, but both one-member regions (transit for WAN, tiers for Web tier) rendered one row-block BELOW their member instead of around it (see frames log rows 30-32 vs Web tier rows 25-28, rows 33-35 vs WAN rows 25-28). Rejected: a declared region that does not enclose its member is a lie in the drawing.
attempts.outcome: rejected (one-member regions detach from their member)

attempts.note: Final v1: same four nodes and three edges in lr, one region 'network' (wan, fw, core) that renders as a titled bordered band enclosing all three members; web tier deliberately ungrouped so no one-member region exists. extent=76x6, 0 bridges, 0 ambiguous owners, origins 3/3.

Mesh in lr (core and web both sources, tiers region). extent=61x12, 1 bridge; the tiers region's top border carried no title because the core->cache route runs along that same row, and the region's left wall collided with the ungrouped Core switch box. Also rendered the core label as 'Coreiswitch'.

Final v2: same four nodes in tb with edges core->cache, web->cache, web->db, cache->db and one region 'tiers' (web, cache, db). extent=28x31; the region is titled ('-- tiers --') and encloses its three members. Known defect kept: the region's rectangle also covers the ungrouped Core switch at its top-left, and its left wall is hidden behind the core box.

Same mesh in tb plus the core->web 10 GbE anchor and a 'network' region for core. extent=32x44 fits, the network region rendered correctly around core, but the region-disjointness pass then gave the tiers region its own column band (cols 46-49) with NO member inside it: an empty, untitled 3-cell box ran down the right side. Rejected in favour of attempt 2.
attempts.outcome: rejected (declared tiers region rendered empty and untitled)
